mapper.insert: INSERT INTO marketing_template_file (original_filename, content_type, size_bytes, content, asset_name, asset_scope, width, height, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{originalFilename}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{content}, #{assetName}, #{assetScope}, #{width}, #{height}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM marketing_template_file WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT , (SELECT gr.group_id FROM resource_asset_group_ref gr WHERE gr.file_id = file.id AND gr.scope = #{q.scope.code}) AS group_id FROM marketing_template_file file
ORDER BY file.created_at DESC, file.id DESC LIMIT #{q.pageSize} OFFSET #{q.offset}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT file.id) FROM marketing_template_file file

SELECT , (SELECT gr.group_id FROM resource_asset_group_ref gr WHERE gr.file_id = file.id AND gr.scope = #{scope}) AS group_id FROM marketing_template_file file WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (asset_scope IS NULL OR asset_scope = #{scope})

SELECT asset_id AS assetId, COUNT(*) AS referenceCount FROM ( SELECT asset_id, source_type, source_id FROM ( SELECT image_file_id AS asset_id, 'marketing_template' AS source_type, id AS source_id FROM marketing_template WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND image_file_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT link_preview_asset_id, 'hyperlink_template', id FROM hyperlink_template WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND link_preview_asset_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT body_main_asset_id, 'hyperlink_template', id FROM hyperlink_template WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND body_main_asset_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT link_preview_asset_id, 'hyperlink_task', hyperlink_task_id FROM hyperlink_task_content WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND link_preview_asset_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT body_main_asset_id, 'hyperlink_task', hyperlink_task_id FROM hyperlink_task_content WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND body_main_asset_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT f.id, 'script_marketing_task', t.id FROM script_marketing_task t INNER JOIN marketing_template_file f ON f.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND JSON_CONTAINS(t.steps_json, CONCAT('{"message":{"imageFileId":', f.id, '}}')) = 1 WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND f.id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT f.id, 'script_marketing_definition', d.id FROM script_marketing_definition d INNER JOIN marketing_template_file f ON f.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND JSON_CONTAINS(d.steps_json, CONCAT('{"message":{"imageFileId":', f.id, '}}')) = 1 WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND f.id IN #{id} ) raw_references GROUP BY asset_id, source_type, source_id ) distinct_references GROUP BY asset_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT source_type, source_id FROM ( SELECT 'marketing_template' AS source_type, id AS source_id FROM marketing_template WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND image_file_id = #{id} UNION ALL SELECT 'hyperlink_template', id FROM hyperlink_template WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND link_preview_asset_id = #{id} UNION ALL SELECT 'hyperlink_template', id FROM hyperlink_template WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND body_main_asset_id = #{id} UNION ALL SELECT 'hyperlink_task', hyperlink_task_id FROM hyperlink_task_content WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND link_preview_asset_id = #{id} UNION ALL SELECT 'hyperlink_task', hyperlink_task_id FROM hyperlink_task_content WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND body_main_asset_id = #{id} UNION ALL SELECT 'script_marketing_task', id FROM script_marketing_task WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND JSON_CONTAINS(steps_json, CONCAT('{"message":{"imageFileId":', #{id}, '}}')) = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'script_marketing_definition', id FROM script_marketing_definition WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND JSON_CONTAINS(steps_json, CONCAT('{"message":{"imageFileId":', #{id}, '}}')) = 1 ) raw_references GROUP BY source_type, source_id ) distinct_references
